samples.summary: Keyboard style toggles (Cmd+B/I/U/S) bypass the new `isAtLinkTrailingEdge` rule and re-arm the hyperlink the change deliberately stops growing
samples.evidence: The diff establishes (caret-style.ts doc comment: "every caller that stores a caret-derived style has to ask this before doing so, or typing silently extends the link") and enforces the rule in two places: `editor.ts:1203` via `pendingStyleFor` and `text-editor.ts:3443` in `clearFormatting`. `TextEditor.toggleStyle` — the keyboard half of Bold/Italic/Underline/Strikethrough — still seeds pending straight from the caret style at `packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:3497`: `this.pending?.set({ ...visual, ...resolved }, this.cursor.position)` where `visual = { ...this.getStyleAtCursor(), ...pending }`. At a link trailing edge `getStyleAtCursor()` carries the run's `href`, and `exitLinkIfAtTrailingEdge` is only invoked on space/Enter/paste (text-editor.ts:981, 2608, 2641, 4171), never on caret placement or after `insertLink` — the very scenario the new test `a toolbar toggle at a link trailing edge does not re-arm the link` covers for the toolbar path. Cmd+B at the same spot then typing a plain character still extends the hyperlink. The fix belongs on this out-of-diff line (route it through the same `isAtLinkTrailingEdge` check).

samples.summary: Slides text-box collapsed-caret font-size step seeds pending with the caret's `href`, bypassing the new trailing-edge guard on the one surface that has no link popover
samples.evidence: `stepSelectionFontSizeImpl`'s collapsed branch does `const base = { ...caretStyle(false), ...staged }; pending.set({ ...base, fontSize: next }, cursor.position)` (packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:881-888). `caretStyle(false)` is `caretInlineStyle(doc, cursor.position, false)`, which at a link's trailing edge reports the link run's `href`, so the next typed character extends the hyperlink. The docs equivalent routes through `applyStyleImpl` → the new `pendingStyleFor` (editor.ts:1306-1317, 1194-1200) and is covered by the new test `stepping the font size at a link trailing edge does not re-arm the link`; the text-box copy has no such guard and this diff did not add one.

samples.summary: The two `removeLink` implementations now diverge: text-box is selection-first, docs `EditorAPI.removeLink` is still caret-only, while the shared frontend contract documents selection precedence
samples.evidence: `packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/types.ts:94-107` now documents `removeLink` as "A selection takes precedence over the caret where the implementation supports one". `packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:1254` implements that; `packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:3737-3755` still resolves purely from `cursor.position` via `findLinkRunAt`. Any surface that renders the new `showRemoveLink` button against the docs `EditorAPI` (the shared `TextFormatGroup` makes that a one-prop change, and `docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx:808` already renders that component) would get the silent no-op after a drag that this change fixed for slides.

samples.summary: Extracting `isAtLinkTrailingEdge` widened its semantics for the pre-existing `exitLinkIfAtTrailingEdge` callers (empty href-residue runs, and header/footer/table blocks via `findBlock`)
samples.evidence: The old private method used `this.doc.getBlock(...)` inside try/catch and required `pos.offset > start`; the extracted version uses `doc.findBlock` and drops the `offset > start` condition (caret-style.ts:80-96). The only other consumer, `exitLinkIfAtTrailingEdge` (text-editor.ts:5912), is reached from typing a space, Enter and paste (text-editor.ts:981, 2608, 2641, 4171); it now fires in cases it previously did not — zero-length `href` residue runs, and blocks `getBlock` used to throw on. finding.summary: Keyboard style toggles (Cmd+B/I/U/S) bypass the new `isAtLinkTrailingEdge` rule and re-arm the hyperlink the change deliberately stops growing
finding.evidence: The diff establishes (caret-style.ts doc comment: "every caller that stores a caret-derived style has to ask this before doing so, or typing silently extends the link") and enforces the rule in two places: `editor.ts:1203` via `pendingStyleFor` and `text-editor.ts:3443` in `clearFormatting`. `TextEditor.toggleStyle` — the keyboard half of Bold/Italic/Underline/Strikethrough — still seeds pending straight from the caret style at `packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:3497`: `this.pending?.set({ ...visual, ...resolved }, this.cursor.position)` where `visual = { ...this.getStyleAtCursor(), ...pending }`. At a link trailing edge `getStyleAtCursor()` carries the run's `href`, and `exitLinkIfAtTrailingEdge` is only invoked on space/Enter/paste (text-editor.ts:981, 2608, 2641, 4171), never on caret placement or after `insertLink` — the very scenario the new test `a toolbar toggle at a link trailing edge does not re-arm the link` covers for the toolbar path. Cmd+B at the same spot then typing a plain character still extends the hyperlink. The fix belongs on this out-of-diff line (route it through the same `isAtLinkTrailingEdge` check).

verdict.reason: Verified in the repo: the new rule's contract (caret-style.ts:71-78 — "every caller that stores a caret-derived style has to ask this before doing so") is enforced in editor.ts:1190-1198/1203 and text-editor.ts:3440-3448, but TextEditor.toggleStyle stores a caret-derived pending style with no such check at text-editor.ts:3497. `visual` derives from getStyleAtCursor() -> caretInlineStyle (text-editor.ts:3547; caret-style.ts:116-120), which at a link trailing edge returns the link run's style including `href`. The path is reachable from the keyboard (Cmd+B/I/U/Shift+X/./, at text-editor.ts:1187-1217) and `pending` is wired for docs (editor.ts:2539), and exitLinkIfAtTrailingEdge only fires on space/Enter/paste (text-editor.ts:981, 2608, 2641, 4171), so pending is not pre-armed on plain caret placement. The new test at test/view/link-trailing-edge.test.ts:310-325 covers exactly this scenario for the toolbar path only, confirming the keyboard half is an unguarded bypass. No guard elsewhere makes it unreachable; it is in-lane (guard with a reachable bypass / diverging call site) and blocking at major.

finding.summary: Slides text-box collapsed-caret font-size step seeds pending with the caret's `href`, bypassing the new trailing-edge guard on the one surface that has no link popover
finding.evidence: `stepSelectionFontSizeImpl`'s collapsed branch does `const base = { ...caretStyle(false), ...staged }; pending.set({ ...base, fontSize: next }, cursor.position)` (packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:881-888). `caretStyle(false)` is `caretInlineStyle(doc, cursor.position, false)`, which at a link's trailing edge reports the link run's `href`, so the next typed character extends the hyperlink. The docs equivalent routes through `applyStyleImpl` → the new `pendingStyleFor` (editor.ts:1306-1317, 1194-1200) and is covered by the new test `stepping the font size at a link trailing edge does not re-arm the link`; the text-box copy has no such guard and this diff did not add one.

verdict.reason: Verified in the repo: text-box-editor.ts:874-891 seeds the collapsed-caret pending style with `{ ...caretStyle(false), ...staged }`, and caretInlineStyle (model/caret-style.ts:116-120) returns the link run's style (including `href`) at a link's trailing edge — the exact hazard the new `pendingStyleFor` guard (editor.ts:1190-1198) fixes for the docs editor via applyStyleImpl (editor.ts:1203, 1316). The text-box surface never imports isAtLinkTrailingEdge or calls pendingStyleFor (only text-editor.ts:25 and editor.ts:29 import it), and TextEditor.exitLinkIfAtTrailingEdge only arms pending on space/Enter/paste (text-editor.ts:981, 2608, 2641, 4171, 5912), not on caret arrival — so after e.g. a caret `insertLink` (text-box-editor.ts:1224-1231) pending is unarmed and the font-size step re-seeds `href`. Reachable from product UI: slides toolbar (frontend text-edit-section.tsx:84, mobile-toolbar.tsx:572) → slides text-box-editor.ts:620 → docs text-box-editor.ts:1077. Fits the blast-radius lane (new guard with an unguarded parallel entry point) and is major.

mergedFrom.summary: New Slides "Remove link" button is wired to a caret-only `removeLink()`, so it silently no-ops when the user selects the linked text (the natural gesture) and the caret/focus lands outside the link run

finding.summary: New Slides "Remove link" button is the only way to drop an href there, but the underlying `removeLink()` is caret-only and silently no-ops for the natural "select the linked text, click Remove link" gesture
finding.evidence: `TextFormatGroup` now renders an always-enabled Remove-link button for Slides (`packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/text-format-group.tsx:176`, opted in at `packages/frontend/src/app/slides/toolbar/text-edit-section.tsx:93` and `mobile-toolbar.tsx:580`). It forwards to `SlidesTextBoxEditor.removeLink` (`packages/slides/src/view/editor/text-box-editor.ts:650`) → docs `TextBoxEditorAPI.removeLink` (`packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:1234-1248`), which resolves the link purely from `cursor.position` via `findLinkRunAt` (`packages/docs/src/view/link-run.ts:33-58`) and returns early when the caret is not inside/at the edge of a linked run. In docs this was safe because Remove link is only offered from the link popover, which appears only when the caret is in a link; the Slides button has no such gate (the diff's own comment at text-format-group.tsx:167-172 says it is deliberately never gated). A user who drag-selects text that extends past the link (focus lands in a non-link run) gets a silent no-op, and since #1051 Clear formatting no longer removes links, there is no fallback path in Slides. Fix belongs either on `removeLink` (use the selection range when one exists) or on the new button's enablement/feedback.

verdict.reason: The finding's central premise — that `TextBoxEditorAPI.removeLink` resolves the link purely from `cursor.position` via `findLinkRunAt` and no-ops when the caret is outside the link — is not present in this tree. `packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:1254-1257` begins `removeLink()` with a selection-first branch (`if (selection.hasSelection() && selection.range) { applyStyleImpl({ href: undefined }); return; }`); the caret/`findLinkRunAt` lookup at 1258-1261 is only the collapsed-caret fallback. `applyStyleImpl` (823-835) writes `{ href: undefined }` across the whole `selection.range`, so the "drag-select past the link, click Remove link" gesture clears the href rather than silently no-opping. The doc comment at 1239-1253 explicitly names that Slides gesture as the reason for the branch, and `packages/docs/test/view/text-box-clear-formatting.test.ts:168-183` asserts it ("removeLink drops a link the selection covers, caret outside it or not"), with an over-reach guard at 185-195. The Slides path does reach this function — `packages/slides/src/view/editor/text-box-editor.ts:446` constructs a docs `TextBoxEditorAPI` and 650-652 delegates straight to it — so the forwarding chain in the finding is right but its terminus behaves differently than claimed. The always-enabled button at `packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/text-format-group.tsx:168-178` exists as described, but with the selection branch present it is not a bypass of anything.
